# computrabajo fixtures

Captured 2026-10-22 from the public Computrabajo Colombia site. Public job listings only; no account, CV or
personal data is included.

## listing.html

Source: `https://co.computrabajo.com/trabajo-de-analista-de-datos-en-bogota-dc` (the listing for the query
`analista de datos` in Bogotá, D.C.). The rows include postings up to 3 days old, so this capture did not use the
`?pubdate=1` window. 20 `<article class="box_offer">` cards, three of them without a company link.

## detail.html

Source: `https://co.computrabajo.com/ofertas-de-trabajo/oferta-de-trabajo-de-analista-de-datos-sql-power-bi-python-en-bogota-dc-42CFA8B9B6EFC83461373E686DCF3405`
— the offer behind the first card of `listing.html`. Carries a JSON-LD `JobPosting`.
